ui_desc_hud: Display and needs settings, organized by category.
ui_desc_self: Movement, spawning, observation and world tools in one place.
ui_desc_bans: Review active bans, their duration and their reasons.
ui_desc_resources: Manage resources and review their running state.
ui_overview_desc: Everything you need to look after your world.
quick_open_hint: The same tools are available in the quick menu
quick_ground_hint: Leave Z empty to find the ground automatically.
quick_pick_player: Select a player to show their tools.
quick_player_frozen: Player is frozen; press freeze to release.
quick_player_hint: Actions apply to the selected player only.

quick_delete_failed: Entity could not be deleted; another resource may control it.

quick_cooldown: Please wait for the current action.

quick_spectate_failed: Could not stream the target; your position was restored.

quick_hint_tpForward: Move to a nearby surface in view

quick_hint_flipVehicle: Put the wagon back on its wheels
quick_hint_vehicleBoost: A bounded speed boost while driving
quick_hint_healMount: Restore the horse you are riding
ui_desc_characters: Every character by citizen ID, online or offline.
ui_ch_pick: Pick a character from the list
ui_ch_kind_history: Logs and history (kept under a 'deleted' label)
ui_ch_what_core: The character itself is deleted; all its balances return to the reserve
ui_ch_what_data: Deleted for good: appearance, needs, settings, keys, memberships, recipes, horses, wagons, stashes, listings and pending deliveries
ui_ch_what_asset: Released back to the game, each its own way: a house goes back on sale without furniture or keys, a store back to the government; a stables business, bank, workbench, tribe or kingdom loses this owner
ui_ch_what_history: Kept, but moved off the number to a 'deleted' label carrying the ID and the time, so nothing stays under the number
ui_ch_what_other: Handled by its own resource on deletion
ui_ch_what_money: Money is never destroyed: every balance of the character (cash, bank, gold, stash cash, pending market payments, its store balances) returns to the reserve through the central bank's ledger; an open loan is written off
ui_ch_block_note: The character cannot be played ("contact the administration"); the account keeps its other characters
ui_ch_reassign_note: A vanity ID: every record of the character moves to the new ID, and its old ID is free at once to give to another character. The character must be offline
ui_ch_transfer: Give this ID to another character
ui_ch_transfer_note: The other character takes this ID with all of its own data, and the current holder moves to a new ID with everything it has. Nothing passes from one to the other; both are kicked if online
ui_ch_transfer_target: Citizen ID of the character that takes it
ui_ch_transfer_holder: %s (citizen ID %s): moves to a new ID
ui_ch_transfer_ask: Give ID %s to "%s"? "%s" moves to a new ID
ui_ch_transfer_running: The transfer is taking longer than 30 seconds; waiting for the server's answer…
ui_ch_transfer_done: ID %s now belongs to "%s"; "%s" moved to ID %s, and ID %s is free
ui_ch_transfer_partial: Only half done: "%s" moved to ID %s, but "%s" did not take ID %s and kept its ID %s
ui_ch_transfer_partial_hint: ID %s has no holder now. Fix the cause, then change the ID of "%s" to it
ui_ch_delete_note: Everything of the character goes, with no leftovers: its own data is deleted, its assets are released back to the game, its money returns to the reserve and its history is kept under a 'deleted' label. An online character is kicked first and its logout saved. The number is then clean and can be given to another character
ui_ch_delete_confirm: Type the citizen ID to confirm
ui_ch_delete_ask: Delete "%s" (ID %s) for good? This cannot be undone
ui_ch_report_free: ID %s is free now and can be given to another character
ui_ch_report_nodata: The character was deleted but the report did not arrive; the details are in the server log
ui_ch_refused_note: Fix the cause, then try again; deleting again is safe and repeats nothing
ui_ch_report_leftovers: Not clean yet: still filed under ID %s:
ui_ch_report_leftovers_hint: The ID is not free yet. The server retries once by itself in 30 seconds; if something is still left, run wcore_purge %s leftovers in the server console
ui_ch_delete_running: The deletion is taking longer than 30 seconds; waiting for the server's answer…
ui_ch_offline_note: The character is offline: actions change its saved data
toast_char_reassigned: Citizen ID changed; the old ID is free for another character
toast_char_deleted_unclean: Character deleted, but records are still filed under its ID
toast_char_delete_running: The deletion is still running; waiting for its answer
toast_char_delete_unknown: No answer from the deletion yet; the server console has its result. Refresh the list in a moment
err_char_id_taken: This ID belongs to another character
err_char_online: The character is online; it must log out first
err_char_assets: An asset was not released because its resource is not running or failed; start that resource, then delete again
err_char_loan: The character has an open loan
err_char_economy: The central bank is not ready; try again shortly
err_char_busy: This character is being deleted or moved to another ID right now; try again shortly
err_char_logout: The character could not be kicked and its logout saved; try again shortly
err_char_not_ready: A resource is not ready; try again shortly
err_char_restarting: The resource is starting or stopping; try again shortly
err_char_res_busy: The resource is busy right now; try again shortly
err_char_balance_changed: Money moved during the deletion; try again
err_char_error: The resource failed with an error; see the server console
err_char_forbidden: Only the admin panel may delete characters
err_char_offline_money: For an offline character: cash or gold, add or remove
err_money_reason: Write why the money is added: it comes out of the central bank reserve and the reason is kept in the log
err_money_cap: You can add at most $%s at a time; only the master can add more
err_money_cap_gold: You can add at most %s gold at a time; only the master can add more
toast_char_transferred: ID %s now belongs to "%s"; "%s" moved to ID %s
toast_char_transfer_running: The transfer is still running; waiting for its answer
toast_char_transfer_unknown: No answer from the transfer yet; the server console has its result. Refresh the list in a moment
err_char_target_not_found: No character with the target ID
err_char_transfer_same: That character already holds this ID
err_char_transfer_unclean: Records were still under the ID after its holder moved, so the other character did not take it
err_char_transfer_partial: The holder moved, but the other character did not take the ID
err_char_no_fresh_id: Could not reserve a new ID; try again shortly
err_char_accounts_changed: The character's accounts changed during the move; try again
err_ranks_core: The rank system (w_core) is not running
err_ranks_loading: The ranks are still loading, try again in a few seconds
err_rank_name: Rank name: lowercase letters, digits and _, 2 to 32, starting with a letter
err_rank_label: Give the rank a display name (64 characters at most)
err_rank_node: A permission is malformed or reserved
err_rank_too_many: Too many permissions in the rank (200 at most)
err_rank_protected: The master rank is protected: it cannot be edited or deleted
err_rank_identifier: Bad identifier — e.g. license:abc123 or steam:110000...
err_rank_not_held: The player does not hold that rank
err_rank_locked: A master from the server config (w_ranks:masters) — the panel cannot take it
err_reports_missing: The website bridge (w_connector) is stopped, so the reports cannot be read
report_not_found: The report was not found, it may have been deleted
report_is_resolved: This report is closed, reopen it first
